database.stem: What is scheduled to happen following the president’s address?
database.raw_text:
What is scheduled to happen following the president’s address?
(A) Participants will enjoy some Chinese cuisine.
(B) The attendees will listen to an opening speech by Jack Thornton.
(C) New employees will participate in group activities.
(D) Staff members will check the list by the front entrance.
database.explanation: CEO的演讲过后，在中餐厅享用午餐。答案是 (A)。

options.A: Participants will enjoy some Chinese cuisine.
options.B: The attendees will listen to an opening speech by Jack Thornton.
options.C: New employees will participate in group activities.
options.D: Staff members will check the list by the front entrance.
